title: Conditional Assignment and Lazy Evaluation
learning_outcomes: Explain the role of conditional assignment and lazy evaluation in a Ruby program and name the key rule involved.
Apply conditional assignment and lazy evaluation in a small example and predict its result before running it.
Identify one boundary or failure case related to conditional initialization and verify the intended behavior.

content.intro: Learn Conditional Assignment and Lazy Evaluation through a visual model, a minimal Ruby example, and a practical check.
content.why_it_matters: Understanding conditional assignment and lazy evaluation helps you write code that is easier to explain, test, and maintain. It also helps separate Ruby language guarantees from runtime assumptions, dependency behavior, and application-specific rules.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Conditional Assignment and Lazy Evaluation helps you reason about ||= and &&=. In Ruby, prefer a small example whose inputs and expected result are easy to explain. This lesson connects the syllabus topic to practical code and highlights where assumptions or edge cases matter.

content_blocks.title: How to think about it
content_blocks.text: Begin by identifying the key rule: ||= and &&=. Then connect it to Defaulting values. The remaining syllabus points—Conditional initialization—are useful checks before applying this in a larger project.

content_blocks.title: Guided example
content_blocks.text: Run the example as written, compare it with the expected result, and explain why each line supports conditional assignment and lazy evaluation. Next change one input or condition and predict the result before running it.

content_blocks.title: Try it yourself
content_blocks.text: Create a second example for conditional assignment and lazy evaluation using a different input. Add one edge case from the syllabus list (Conditional initialization), state the expected behavior, and write a small test or manual check that would catch a regression.

content_blocks.title: Recap
content_blocks.text: You should now be able to explain conditional assignment and lazy evaluation, identify its place in conditional logic and control flow, run a focused example, and verify an important boundary. Revisit the linked exercise if this is a core topic; advanced runtime or framework examples remain draft until reviewed in a suitable environment.
